about: Every update to My PD, oldest first. The app's files live in c3jumpw/mkp-tools (folder pdl) and Vercel publishes them to mypd.mkcworkspace.com on every push. The library itself (media, covers, summaries, transcripts, collections, Trash) stays in c1jumpw/mkp-tools/pdl/media. Releases up to 2026.10.10 were rebuilt from the commit history of pdl/index.html in c1jumpw/mkp-tools; the commits listed there are the uploads that make up each release. The app reads this file to show What's new: items for everyone after unlocking, admin items on devices that use Organize. A device that has never seen What's new (a new phone, or any device at a new address) is shown only the newest release. Releases older than announceSince are history only and are never announced.

fields.versions: file versions in the release, matching each file's VERSION HISTORY
fields.commits: commit ids in the repo named by repo (default c1jumpw/mkp-tools)

releases.title: The library opens
releases.summary: First version of the Personal Development Library page.

items.title: Your library on one page
items.text: Folders and files from pdl/media, with search and Audio, Video and Docs filters.

items.title: Today's Practice
items.text: One audio track picked each day to return to.

items.title: Mini-player and viewer
items.text: Audio plays at the bottom of the screen while you browse; video and documents open in a viewer.

items.title: Organize mode
items.text: Rename and move files and create folders. At this stage it needed a GitHub token saved in the browser.

releases.title: Collections, and saves through the relay
releases.summary: Collections arrive, and the GitHub token leaves the device.

items.title: Collections
items.text: Group items from any folder into named collections without moving them.

items.title: Saves go through the relay
items.text: Renames, moves and collection changes are sent through the pdl-relay Cloudflare Worker, which holds the GitHub token. No token is kept on the phone.

releases.title: Passcode, themes and large files
releases.summary: A passcode lock, dark and light themes, and support for large files.

items.title: Passcode lock
items.text: A four-digit passcode, asked once on each device.

items.title: Dark and light themes
items.text: Switch with the moon and sun button. Remembered on each device.

items.title: Large files
items.text: Files stored in parts, or as GitHub release files, play and open like any other.

items.title: Trash folder
items.text: The trash button moves a file into a trash folder instead of deleting it.

items.title: Clearer relay errors
items.text: Plain messages when the relay address or app key is wrong, instead of a bare network error.

items.title: Large files move whole
items.text: Moving or renaming a file stored in parts moves every part in a single save.

releases.title: Speed, skip and transcripts
releases.summary: Better listening controls and a place for transcripts.

items.title: Playback speed and 15-second skip
items.text: 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x or 2x, remembered for next time, plus back and forward 15 seconds. Video gets the same speed button.

items.title: Transcripts
items.text: Read a track's transcript under the player when one has been added.

items.title: Faster opening
items.text: Today's Practice is worked out once a day instead of on every visit.

releases.title: Transcript editor and progress bar
releases.summary: Transcripts that follow along, and a bar you can drag.

items.title: Transcript editor
items.text: Tap along while you listen, or paste text or SRT and VTT captions.

items.title: Transcripts follow the track
items.text: The current line is highlighted as it plays. Tap any line to jump to that moment.

items.title: Draggable progress bar
items.text: Drag or tap the bar to jump to any point.

items.title: Collections show instantly
items.text: Collections are remembered on the device, so they appear before the network answers.

releases.title: Time display
releases.summary: See where you are in a track.

items.title: Time played and time left
items.text: Shown under the progress bar in the mini-player.

releases.title: The Vault
releases.summary: A personal vocabulary and knowledge base beside the media library.

items.title: Vault: Terms
items.text: Save words and phrases with a definition, an example and your notes. Look it up fills them in with AI.

items.title: Linked to the moment
items.text: A new entry links to the track you were playing and the moment in it. Jump to source plays it from there.

items.title: Subjects, suggestions and attachments
items.text: Tag entries with several subjects, take AI subject suggestions, ask for a new example, and attach a file.

items.title: Ask a follow-up
items.text: Ask questions about a term and add the answers to your notes.

items.title: App icon and tab icons
items.text: A proper icon in the browser tab, and icons on the Browse, Collections and Vault tabs.

items.title: Reliability fixes
items.text: A round of fixes across the library from a full review of the app.

items.title: Relay settings restored
items.text: The relay address and app key were briefly reset to placeholders in an update and were restored the same afternoon.

releases.title: Ideas, Topics and uploads in the app
releases.summary: The Vault grows to three kinds of entry, and files can be uploaded from the app.

items.title: Ideas journal
items.text: Write an idea as it comes. The note stays word for word, with an AI summary and your reflection beside it.

items.title: Topics
items.text: For concepts you want to understand: a simple explanation first, a full explainer when you want it.

items.title: Filter by subject
items.text: Sort the Vault by subject and pick the subjects to show.

items.title: Greeting by time of day
items.text: Good morning, good day or good evening.

items.title: + Upload in the app
items.text: Upload files straight into the folder or collection you're in.

items.title: Faster playback
items.text: Media is served through the jsDelivr CDN, with GitHub as the fallback.

releases.title: Summaries and sturdier uploads
releases.summary: Summaries for every item, a better document viewer, and uploads that survive a weak signal.

items.title: Summaries
items.text: Items with a summary show 📝. Write one, or let ✨ Summarize draft it from the transcript.

items.title: Keep listening when the screen locks
items.text: Video sound carries on when the phone locks, and the lock screen shows the title with working controls.

items.title: Documents open in the app
items.text: A progress bar while loading, Open and Download on iPhone, and text files shown right in the viewer.

items.title: Large uploads recover
items.text: Files of 20 MB or more get two tries as a single upload, then switch to 4 MB parts with automatic retries, so a dropped signal no longer loses the whole file.

items.title: Screen stays awake during uploads
items.text: The app asks the phone to keep the screen on until uploads finish.

releases.title: Trash, cover art and pull to refresh
releases.summary: A 30-day Trash, cover art with a grid view, and streaming for large files.

items.title: Trash with 30 days to undo
items.text: Restore puts a file back where it came from, Delete forever removes it now, and anything left for 30 days is removed automatically.

items.title: Grid view with cover art
items.text: Switch between list and grid. Grid shows each item's cover.

items.title: Cover art and collection headers
items.text: Crop and save a square cover for any item, and a wide header image for each collection.

items.title: Pull to refresh
items.text: Pull down at the top of any list to reload it.

items.title: Large uploads always go in parts
items.text: Files of 20 MB or more now go straight to 4 MB parts. Parts can be played in the app; GitHub release files could only be downloaded.

items.title: Large files stream
items.text: Files stored in parts start playing straight away through the relay instead of downloading first.

items.title: New covers show at once
items.text: A cover you just saved appears on your device without waiting for GitHub.

items.title: New files appear on refresh
items.text: Refreshing now skips GitHub's cached folder list, so a file uploaded moments ago shows up.

releases.title: Tidier collections and safer uploads
releases.summary: Fixes that keep summaries, covers and tags attached to the right file.

items.title: Summary from the viewer
items.text: The 📝 button in the video and document viewer opens the item's summary.

items.title: Clean up missing
items.text: Finds collection tags pointing at files that no longer exist and offers to remove them.

items.title: Asks before replacing
items.text: Uploading a file whose name is already in the folder asks first. Its summary and transcript stay attached.

items.title: Extras move with their file
items.text: Summaries, transcripts and covers now follow a file when it's renamed, moved or trashed.

items.title: Playback fallback
items.text: If the CDN can't play a file, the app now always tries GitHub before giving up.

releases.title: Renamed to My PD
releases.summary: A shorter name for the app.

items.title: My PD
items.text: The app is now My PD – Personal Development Library. Added to a home screen, its label reads My PD, and the lock screen player shows My PD.

releases.title: Guide, What's new and a new address
releases.summary: A built-in guide, update notes like these, and a new home at mypd.mkcworkspace.com.
releases.versions: index.html v13 · guide.html v2 · changelog.json v1
releases.note: Includes the guide prepared on 30 October 2026. First release served from c3jumpw/mkp-tools through Vercel; earlier history stays in c1jumpw/mkp-tools.

items.title: 📖 Guide
items.text: A picture guide to every screen. Tap Guide under the Organize switch; it opens at the part you're using.

items.title: What's new
items.text: After an update, a short summary like this one shows the first time you open My PD.

items.title: New address: mypd.mkcworkspace.com
items.text: Bookmark the new address, or add it to your home screen again. It asks for the passcode once more, and theme and speed start fresh.

items.title: Change log
items.text: Every update since July, in order, in the guide's admin section. Admin-only notes like this one show the first time Organize is switched on after an update.

items.title: Renaming on a phone
items.text: The rename box now drops onto its own line instead of running off the screen.

items.title: App files moved to c3jumpw/mkp-tools
items.text: index.html, guide.html and changelog.json now live in c3jumpw/mkp-tools, folder pdl, and Vercel publishes them to mypd.mkcworkspace.com on every push. The library's media stays in c1jumpw/mkp-tools/pdl/media, so uploads, renames and Trash work as before.
